verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers automated pull request reviews with contextual feedback and suggestions (gh-10) and on-demand @gemini-cli help in PRs (gh-12). A hands-on user report says Gemini code review caught multiple potential bugs that reviewers might have missed (comm-20). Non-interactive scripting with JSON output (gh-6, gh-17) could plug it into pre-merge automation, but the evidence never shows local diff inspection or running tests and linters as checks. missing for 10: documented interactive diff viewing/approval of changes, explicit running of tests/lint/CI checks before merge, in-depth docs on the review workflow.
